site.metaTitle: SwapSpot - Wana Rubatsiro Rwepedyo Runovimbika Padyo Newe
site.metaDescription: Bhuka vabatsiri vepedyo vanovimbika vekuchenesa, kugadzirisa, runako, kutarisira uswa, kutamisa, kutarisira mhuka, kutarisira vakuru, kudzidzisa, nezvimwe.
site.hero.body: Bhuka kuchenesa, kugadzirisa, runako, kutarisira uswa, rubatsiro rwekutamisa, kutarisira mhuka nezvimwe kubva pamusika mumwe wenharaunda.
site.hero.review: Ndakabhuka mugadziri weimba arikugara padyo mumaminetsi 10.
site.how.title: Rubatsiro ruri pamatinya matatu
site.how.body: Kubva pakuti ndinoda izvi zviitwe kusvika zvabhukwa, pasina kudaidzana kwakawandisa, kufungidzira, kana mitengo isinganzwisisike.
site.steps.0.1: Ona vabatsiri vepedyo vanovimbika pamepu inoratidza zvazvino, vakarongwa nechinhambwe nechiyero.
site.steps.1.1: Tarisa maprofaira, sevhisi, nemitengo yakajeka usati wazvipira.
site.steps.2.1: Nyora, wana mutengo wakataurwa, ubhadhare zvakachengeteka mukati meapp.
site.helpers.title: Shandura unyanzvi hwako kuita mari yepedyo
site.helpers.body: Gadzira kamwe chete, wotanga kubhukwa nevavakidzani vari kuda chaizvo zvauri kuita.
site.helpers.freeBody: Chengeta 100% yaunowana. SwapSpot haitore komishoni, muzana, kana mari yekuwana vatengi.
site.perks.0.1: Nyora unyanzvi, mifananidzo, nenzvimbo yaunoshandira mumaminetsi.
site.perks.2.1: Wana zvikumbiro zvepedyo wopindura nemitengo yakataurwa.
site.perks.3.1: Wana zviyero zvinoita kuti mabasa ekutanga ave vatengi venguva dzose.
site.categories.title: Chero basa ripi, kune mubatsiri
site.categories.body: Zvikamu zvikuru zvesevhisi dzepedyo pakutanga, dzichiwedzerwa musika wega wega uchikura.
site.trust.title: Yakagadzirirwa kuti divi rimwe nerimwe rinzwe rakachengeteka
site.trust.body: Ongororo chaidzo, mameseji akavanzika, nezvekutonga zvinoita kuti vavakidzani vatonge data yavo pachavo.
site.trustItems.0.1: Zviyero chaizvo kubva kuvavakidzani chaivo mushure mebasa rega rega.
site.trustItems.1.1: Chengeta hurukuro nemitengo yakataurwa panzvimbo imwe.
site.trustItems.2.1: Shuma kana kuvharira chero mushandisi chero nguva.
site.trustItems.3.1: Bvisa akaundi yako nedata chero nguva yaunosarudza.
site.trustItems.4.1: Vabatsiri vanotonga kuti nzvimbo yavo inoratidzwa sei.

site.waitlist.body: Tarisa vabatsiri vari padyo pasina mari. Shandisa tikiti kana wagadzirira kunyora, kukumbira mitengo yakataurwa, kana kubhuka.
site.waitlist.noSpam: Dhawunirodha app, tarisa vabatsiri, utange kana wagadzirira.

directory.indexMetaDescription: Tarisa mapeji eruzhinji eSwapSpot nezvikamu nemusika wepedyo. Wana kuchenesa, kugadzirisa, kutamisa, kudzidzisa, kutarisira mhuka, runako, sevhisi dzehunyanzvi, nezvimwe.
directory.indexIntro: Mapeji aya anogadzirwa kubva kusevhisi dzevabatsiri dzakaburitswa muSwapSpot. Anobatsira vatengi kuwana mienzaniso chaiyo yesevhisi nedhorobha, kodhi yeposvo, nharaunda, chikamu, mutengo, mutauro, nechiyero.
directory.byCountryBody: Rinki rega rega pazasi rinovhura peji reruzhinji. Kana mubatsiri achibudisa nzvimbo itsva yekushanda, inoonekwa pano mushure mekuvandudzwa kwecache yesaiti.
directory.emptyBody: Dhairekitori inogadzirwa kubva kusevhisi dzevabatsiri dzakaburitswa. Kana pasina rinki dziri kuoneka pano, dzoka munguva pfupi kana kuti vhura app utarise vabatsiri vari padyo newe.
directory.pairMetaDescription: Wana vabatsiri ve{categoryLower} mu{market}. Enzanisa mienzaniso yeruzhinji yesevhisi, nzvimbo dzekushanda, mitengo, mitauro, nezviyero usati wavhura SwapSpot.
directory.pairOgDescription: Tarisa sevhisi dze{categoryLower} dziri padyo ne{market} woenderera muapp yeSwapSpot.
directory.pairSummaryEmpty: SwapSpot iri kugadzirira mienzaniso yevabatsiri ve{categoryLower} mu{market}. Vhura app kuti utarise vabatsiri vari padyo, wenzanise nzvimbo dzekushanda, ukumbire mitengo yakataurwa.
directory.pairSummary: Enzanisa mienzaniso yeruzhinji yesevhisi dze{categoryLower} kubva kuvabatsiri vepedyo ne{market}. Shandisa app kana wagadzirira kunyora, kukumbira mutengo wakataurwa, kana kubhuka.
directory.popularBody: Sevhisi idzi dzinobva kumaprofaira evabatsiri akaburitswa, kwete runyoro rwakagadzirwa mberi.
directory.areaBody: Mapeji eruzhinji anoratidza nharaunda, makodhi eposvo, maguta, uye radhiyasi yesevhisi kuti vatengi vawane rubatsiro rwepedyo vasingaburitsi kero dzakavanzika.
directory.namesBody: Sevhisi dzevabatsiri dzinoitwa mazita anotsvakika, mashoko epedyo, nemapeji ezvikamu kuti vatengi vatsvage mabasa chaiwo avanoda.
directory.inAppBody: Webhusaiti inobatsira vanhu kuwana sevhisi. SwapSpot inochengeta mitengo yakataurwa, mameseji, mabhukingi, ongororo, nezvekuchengetedza mukati meapp yeruoko.
directory.pairFaq1Q: Ndinogona kubhuka vabatsiri ve{categoryLower} mu{market} papeji iri here?
directory.pairFaq1A: Peji iri rewebhusaiti muenzaniso weruzhinji wekuwana. Dhawunirodha SwapSpot kuti unyorere vabatsiri, ukumbire mitengo yakataurwa, ugovane kero chaiyo, uye utonge mabhukingi.
directory.pairFaq2Q: Kero chaiyo dzevabatsiri dziri dzeruzhinji here?
directory.pairFaq2A: Aiwa. SwapSpot inoratidza nzvimbo dzekushanda dzinofungidzirwa dzakadai semakodhi eposvo, nharaunda, maguta, kana radhiyasi. Kero chaiyo dzinoramba dzakavanzika uye dzinogona kugovaniswa muchati chete kana mativi ose agadzirira.
directory.pairFaq3A: Aiwa. Vabatsiri vanogona kugadzira purofaira nekuisa sevhisi vasina komishoni kana muzana weSwapSpot. Vatengi vanobhadhara kuti vapinde kana vachida kunyora, kukumbira mitengo yakataurwa, kana kubhuka.
directory.pairListDescription: Mienzaniso yeruzhinji yesevhisi dze{categoryLower} dzinowanikwa kuburikidza neSwapSpot mu{market}.
directory.cardsEmptyBody: SwapSpot iri kuvhura maprofaira evabatsiri vepedyo nemusika. Dhawunirodha app kuti uone sevhisi dziri padyo, wenzanise mitengo, unyorere vabatsiri kana wagadzirira.
directory.cardsBody: Enzanisa sevhisi, mitengo, nzvimbo, mitauro, zviyero, noruzivo rwevabatsiri padyo ne{market}. Kero chaiyo nekubata zvakananga zvinoramba zviri mukati meSwapSpot.

directory.areasBody: Mapeji evabatsiri eruzhinji anopa injini dzekutsvaga nevatengi mamiriro anokwana: mazita esevhisi, nharaunda, maguta, nzvimbo dzinofungidzirwa, nezviratidzo zvemutauro. Ruzivo rwekubata chaiyo runoramba ruri mukati meSwapSpot.

forClients.body: Vhura app, ona vari padyo, enzanisa maprofaira chaiwo, nyora mukati meSwapSpot, wobhuka kana zvanzwika zvakanaka.
forClients.cards.0.1: Tsvaga nechikamu, chinhambwe, chiyero, uye kuwanikwa.

cookieConsent.title: Sarudzo dzako dzekuvanzika
cookieConsent.body: Tinoshandisa makuki eGoogle Analytics kuti tinzwisise kushanyirwa uye kuvandudza SwapSpot. Unogona kugamuchira kana kurambira makuki ekuongorora asingamanikidzwi.
maintenance.text: SwapSpot iri kutamira kumaseva matsva. Kwechinguva chinosvika awa rimwe, kupinda, kugadzirisazve pasiwedhi, nekushandura akaundi zvingasashanda. Edza zvakare gare gare zvishoma.
reset.title: Gadzirisazve pasiwedhi yako
reset.intro: Sarudza pasiwedhi itsva, wozopinda muapp yeSwapSpot neimeri yako nepasiwedhi itsva.
reset.done: Pasiwedhi yako yashandurwa. Vhura app yeSwapSpot wopinda.
reset.invalid: Rinki iyi yekugadzirisazve haishande kana kuti yapera nguva. Kumbira imwe itsva muapp.
reset.openLink: Vhura rinki yekugadzirisazve iri muimeri yako kuti uenderere.
reset.unavailable: Kugadzirisazve pasiwedhi hakuna kuwanikwa pasaiti ino parizvino.
